name: 328. Native Messages passthrough carries the redaction adapters for every provider (native messages adapters)
description: A provider that implements AnthropicMessagesEndpoint (anthropic, xai, moonshot) is sent /anthropic/v1/messages as the caller's bytes. A runtime-redaction guardrail can change such a body only through the Anthropic raw-body adapters on the request context, and those were installed only for Claude Code requests to Claude models, so a native Messages request to xAI or Moonshot, or a plain one to Anthropic, would have left unredacted. transports/bifrost-http/integrations/anthropic.go now installs the four adapters for every native Messages selection (installAnthropicNativeMessagesAdapters), and core keeps them on a passthrough attempt to a non-Anthropic provider. The redaction itself is pinned in Go, where a guardrail can be put in the pipeline: TestAnthropicNativeMessagesRedaction (every capable provider, buffered and streamed, with and without a guardrail) and TestAnthropicNativeMessagesRedactionCoversEveryCapableProvider. The harness profile has no guardrail plugin, so these cases pin the other half of the rule on the live wire: with no guardrail configured, the adapters change nothing. A marker string sent in the user turn reaches the vendor and comes back in the vendor's own response, buffered and streamed, through the native passthrough.

item.name: /anthropic/v1/messages - native passthrough unchanged with the redaction adapters installed - xai/grok-4-0709

exec: pm.test('native messages adapters xai/grok-4-0709: 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('native messages adapters xai/grok-4-0709: the vendor\'s Messages body reaches the caller unchanged (no guardrail configured)', function () {
var text = (j.content || []).filter(function (b) { return b.type === 'text'; }).map(function (b) { return b.text; }).join('');
pm.test('native messages adapters xai/grok-4-0709: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {

pm.test('native messages adapters xai/grok-4-0709: served by the native passthrough', function () { pm.expect(j.status, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('success'); pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.stream, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('native messages adapters xai/grok-4-0709: log row finalized', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' still processing or missing after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
